title: Couscous de maïs (Nery massardi, Maize Flour Couscous)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: A little maize flour mixed with cold water into a ‘milk’, poured into boiling water and cooked about 15 minutes after the boil returns; more flour is stirred in and cooked about 10 minutes more.
longDesc: p. 4 of the October 2023 recipe book. Three flour routes are given: simple, crushed unsoaked, and crushed and soaked (about 8 hours, dried about 2 hours, then ground). Water is boiled; a little flour is mixed with cold water into a ‘milk’ (the bran), poured into the boiling water with stirring, and cooked about 15 minutes after the boil returns. The maize flour is then added, stirred with a wooden pestle or spatula, and cooked about 10 minutes more. No quantities are printed.
ingredients: Cold water for the ‘milk’ — quantity not printed
steps: Prepare the flour: clean and grind the grains and sieve; or moisten, remove the skins, winnow, crush and grind; or crush, soak about 8 hours, dry about 2 hours and grind.
Boil water. Mix a little flour with cold water into a ‘milk’.
Pour the ‘milk’ into the boiling water, stirring. Cook about 15 minutes after the boil returns.
Add the maize flour, stirring with a wooden pestle or spatula to prevent lumps.
Cook about 10 more minutes. Serve with a sauce.
chefTips: Printed cues: boiling water and stirring to prevent lumps.
The book gives no flour-to-water ratio.
Serve with a sauce, as the book pairs it throughout.
commonMistakes: Using too little water, which gives a hard mass.
Not waiting for the boil to return before timing.
healthBenefits: Maize couscous is a plain starch staple.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Couscous de maïs (Nery massardi)’ (p. 4). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 4 and prep are placeholders. TWO-PASS.
ABSENT: flour and water quantities. The three flour routes are as printed.
